newsitem.title: USA: VitalCom Inc sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: VitalCom Inc sees Q3 loss.

text.p: VitalCom Inc, a maker of healthcare communications networks, said Monday it expects to report a net loss for the third quarter ending September 30 on lower revenue expectations.
Analysts had expected VitalCom to report a profit of $0.04 a share, according to First Call, an investment research firm.

VitalCom said in a statement it expects revenues to fall from the second quarter, in which it posted 6.0 million of sales, due chiefly to longer sales cycles that are associated with large order sizes and changes in its markeing and sales organization.

The company said fixing its problems is taking longer than expected and, as a result, fourth quarter revenue and operating results will fall below the year ago fourth quarter, when the company earned $0.12 a share.
Analysts had expected the company to earn $0.09 a share in the fourth quarter, according to First Call.

VitalCom said as potential customers evaluate its system for distributing clinical information in real-time at hospitals, they are seeking to order larger networks. The result has been longer than expected waits for approval.
Addressing the changes in its sales cycle and overcoming a realignment of its sales force also has taken longer than the company expected.
VitalCom said it remains confident in its busines market and opportunity. It noted it has $23 million in cash and cash equivalents and no long term debt.
